description: JavaScript functions for TinyMCE advimage plugin popup, handling image insertion, editing, and UI interactions.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Initializes the plugin popup, loads external image list URL if specified.

methods.name: convertURL
methods.description: Converts a URL using a callback specified in tinyMCE settings.

methods.name: getImageSrc
methods.description: Extracts the src attribute value from a string containing 'this.src='.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the image dialog, populates form fields with current image attributes, sets up UI elements.

methods.name: setSwapImageDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables swap image controls.

methods.name: setAttrib
methods.description: Sets an attribute on an image element, handling style and special cases.

methods.name: makeAttrib
methods.description: Creates an attribute string with proper XML encoding.

methods.name: insertAction
methods.description: Inserts or updates an image element in the editor based on form data.

methods.name: cancelAction
methods.description: Closes the popup without making changes.

methods.name: changeAppearance
methods.description: Updates the sample image appearance based on form selections.

methods.name: changeMouseMove
methods.description: Enables or disables swap image controls based on checkbox.

methods.name: updateStyle
methods.description: Updates the style attribute based on form inputs.

methods.name: styleUpdated
methods.description: Syncs style attribute changes back to form inputs.

methods.name: changeHeight
methods.description: Adjusts image height proportionally if constrain is enabled.

methods.name: changeWidth
methods.description: Adjusts image width proportionally if constrain is enabled.

methods.name: onSelectMainImage
methods.description: Handles selection of a main image from the list.

methods.name: showPreviewImage
methods.description: Displays a preview of the selected image.

methods.name: updateImageData
methods.description: Updates form fields with the loaded image's dimensions.

methods.name: resetImageData
methods.description: Resets image dimension fields.

methods.name: getSelectValue
methods.description: Retrieves the selected value from a dropdown.

methods.name: getImageListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for an image list dropdown.
